#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Woah! That’s a lot of clothes you bought, you know?
Lady Annalie: In total you have spent in this shop...
Lady Annalie: *typing*
Lady Annalie: Exactly {f_Integer}$.
You: Don’t worry. I can afford it, you know? Have some more faith in me...
Lady Annalie: Don’t tell me…
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Are you perhaps rich or something mister? Hmm~ 
Lady Annalie: Maybe we should get to know each other closer after all~
You: Uhhhh…{{wi}} Well…
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Oh come on man! I was only joking!
Lady Annalie: You tensed up immediately lol, such a vanilla~
You: Please, don’t tease me like that…
Lady Annalie: No can’t do. 
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Without teasing…{{wi}} My life would lose its purpose…
You: …
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Anyway, I hope miss girlfriend will like these new buys.
You: I hope so too.
Lady Annalie: See you soon~!
